cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Získání teoretických i praktických zkušeností se zaměřováním a vyhodnocením objektu. Schopnost identifikovat a vyhodnotit poruchy dle vnějších příznaků, provést návrh řešení obnovy budovy jako celku s výběrem vhodného pracovního postupu při respektování případné historické hodnoty. Graficky zpracovat technická řešení.

en.label: Prerequisites:
en.content: State Bachelor Examination and not Building Reconstruction Focused on Timber Structures
Terminology related to reconstruction of buildings, the life of buildings, the possibility of reconstruction of older buildings, renovation of building sites. (allowance 1/2)
Basic construction systems and design principles based on the historic building regulations. (allowance 1/0)
Disorders and symptoms of disorders of bearing and non-bearing structure from foundation to roof and maintenance. (allowance 1/4)
Design principles for the reconstruction drawings. Projects of reconstruction, adaptation and modernization. Drawings of the existing condition and its evaluation. (allowance 1/2)
Technical-economical issues of reconstruction, pre-project preparation and project development. (allowance 1/2)
Existing legislation in the Czech Republic, normative environment and related regulations, environmental links. (allowance 1/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim is to obtain basic knowledge and overview in the implementation of reconstruction, modernization, as well as repair and maintenance facility. Introduce students wi. the terminology, design principles and project design solutions to basic defects and failures of buildings, including principles of charting, applicable regulations and standards.
